description_en: Queries the details of all components supported by the platform
description_zh: 查询平台支持的所有组件的详情
name: DescribeAddons

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the cluster is deployed
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
Kubernetes: ACK dedicated cluster.

ManagedKubernetes: ACK ACK clusters, including ACK ACK clusters (ACK Pro and ACK Basic), ACK Serverless clusters (Pro and Basic), ACK Edge clusters (Pro and Basic), and ACK Lingjun clusters (Pro).

ExternalKubernetes: registered cluster
parameters.help_zh:
`Kubernetes`: ACK专有集群。

`ManagedKubernetes`：ACK托管类的集群，包括ACK托管集群（ACK集群Pro版、ACK集群基础版）、ACK Serverless集群（Pro版、基础版）、ACK Edge集群（Pro版、基础版）、ACK灵骏集群（Pro版）。

`ExternalKubernetes`：注册集群
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en:
The cluster profile. Valid values:
Default: managed cluster.
Serverless: Serverless cluster.
Edge: edge cluster
parameters.help_zh:
集群类型，取值：
`Default`：托管版集群。
`Serverless`：Serverless集群。
`Edge`：边缘集群
parameters.name: cluster_profile

parameters.help_en:
The cluster specifications. You can specify this parameter when you set cluster_type to ManagedKubernetes and configure profile. Valid values:

ack.pro.small: ACK Pro.

ack.standard: ACK Basic. This is the default value if this parameter is left empty
parameters.help_zh:
当您选择`cluster_type`为`ManagedKubernetes`并配置`profile`后，您可以进一步指定集群的规格。

`ack.pro.small`：集群Pro版。

`ack.standard`：集群基础版（取值为空时默认选择）
parameters.name: cluster_spec

items.description_en: The details of the component group

group_name.description_en: The name of the component group

items.description_zh: 该分组内包含的组件名称

ComponentGroups.title_en: 组件分组信息，例如：存储类组件，网络组件等。
ComponentGroups.title_zh: 组件分组信息，例如：存储类组件，网络组件等。

additionalProperties.description_en: The details of the standard component

description.description_en: The description of the component features

disabled.description_en:
Specifies whether to disable the default installation of the component. When a cluster is created, components required for the cluster are installed. In addition, some components related to logs or routing, such as Ingress, are installed by default. If you do not want to install these components by default, you can set this parameter to disable the default installation. Valid values:

true: disables the default installation.
false: enables the default installation
disabled.description_zh:
是否禁止默认安装，集群创建时除了安装集群所需的组件外，还会额外安装一些与日志或者路由相关的组件（例如：Ingress），如果您不想默认安装，可通过设置该字段禁止默认安装。取值：

`true`：禁止默认安装。
`false`：默认安装

required.description_en:
Specifies whether the component is required for the cluster. Valid values:

true: The component is required and must be installed when the cluster is created.

false: The component is not required. You can install it in the Components module after the cluster is created
required.description_zh:
是否为集群必需组件。取值：

`true`：必需组件，集群创建时必须要安装的组件。

`false`：非必需组件，集群创建完成后，可通过`组件管理`进行安装

StandardComponents.title_en: 标准组件信息，包含各个组件的描述信息。
StandardComponents.title_zh: 标准组件信息，包含各个组件的描述信息。
